commands.desc: Kill all node.exe processes and report RAM freed
commands.script: $before = (Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).FreePhysicalMemory; taskkill /f /im node.exe 2>&1; $after = (Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).FreePhysicalMemory; $freed = [math]::Round(($after - $before)/1024); Write-Host ('RAM freed: ' + $freed + ' MB | Free now: ' + [math]::Round($after/1024) + ' MB')
